title: Cuebook
user: Bedroom DJs, VJs, and educators who need to rehearse a music-reactive visual set with reliable cue points, not gamble on a live spectrum visualizer.
smallest_useful_product: Offline web cuebook that imports user-owned audio, stores manual time/beat markers, previews a small set of deterministic visual scenes, and exports a cue JSON plus rehearsal video.
success_measure: A creator can recreate five marked visual transitions within ±150 ms across two rehearsals of the same track.
constraints: Audio stays on device; account for browser audio-clock drift; visual presets use original assets only; beat detection is advisory.
